memory_candidates.content: Lean 4: a scoped notation whose token, precedence, AND associativity exactly match a core notation (e.g. 'infixr:25 " → "' vs the function arrow, 'infixr:30 " ∨ "' vs Or) makes every use site a parser choice node; nested chains then cost Theta(2^n) elaborator backtracking. Fix: offset the precedence by one (Cslib's HasAnd 'infixr:36' vs core 35 is the collision-free pattern). Diagnostic signature: deterministic-timeout that maxHeartbeats cannot bound (per-alternative timeouts are swallowed by 'observing' in choice elaboration, src/lean/Lean/Elab/App.lean), flat RSS, one pegged core, and uniform counters across ~40 Coe* instances under 'set_option diagnostics true'.

Lake only flushes a module's diagnostics when the whole module finishes elaborating. A file that hangs at declaration N therefore hides real, already-raised errors from earlier declarations in the same file ('no diagnostics' is NOT evidence of no errors). To surface them, truncate the file after the suspect region and lake-build the truncated module.

To discriminate where a heartbeat-immune Lean 'hang' lives: pin 'set_option maxHeartbeats 1000' and measure wall time vs input size. If runtime still scales (e.g. 2^n) and the deterministic-timeout error only surfaces at the end, the cost is a backtracking walk over alternatives (each alternative's timeout is caught and treated as failure), not a single monitored computation - and no heartbeat bump can fix it. Kernel defeq is NOT the only heartbeat-immune suspect.
